[quote=the_crystalline_empire;60587452]The confusion had not been too bad for the two gentlemen onboard of the plane, it had been assumed that the escort was standard practice, and shrugged off, though back home the government of Thýven had watched with a rising tension that had eventually dissolved once word had reached that they had landed safely on the tarmac. 

Alfred Erjksson a moderatly sized Thrømm moved forward and recieved the handshake with due politeness stating, "An impressive feat of coordination First Consul,"

In the meantime Elbert Mürre had finally disembarked the plane after paying the pilot a tip for his troubles, unlike Alfred, Elbert was a human, with grey hair that had once been brown and a sagging facial complexion that made him look like a sad puppy, stepping up he stated in what could be taken to have been, "Greetings, it is an honour to meet you," though it sounded more like a drunk trying to say it due to the deep gravelly tone of Elbert. [/quote]

A press team from Republic Now!, one of the largest news services in the country that had risen to prominence during the revolution, is noticeably in the background recording the exchange, having also arrived by helicopter a few minutes before the plane landed.

"It's also an honor to host you both in the Republic. However unexepected your visit may be, the gesture, especially only hours after relations were restored, is welcomed."

He looks towards the airport's terminal, mostly covered by scaffolding and workers bustling about their various tasks. Muller himself is very warm in speaking; his hair is beginning to gray, but otherwise, he still looks young for his age.

"We will have a transport to the Palace of the Republic soon, my office is there, for now at least. Like the airport you see here, most of the city is like this. So, if it looks like a mess, well, that's because it is. There's a reason why we have a special authority delegated to rebuilding this place after all. So, preemptively, sorry for the mess. I would have much preferred to meet in Téiernsbuer."

Elbert had pulled out a fat cigar and was now smoking it speaking to his counterpart Alfred and to Muller, "Nonsense, there is capital to be had in this reconstruction, where others see destruction I see potential,"

Alfred nodded politely, edging the conversation from stalling, "Well, architecture aside, I myself am surprised at my sudden journey here, it hasn't even been a few hours, I suppose our government is eager to establish an ally in such a crucial part of the White Strait,"
